title: Launch Beacon: compact onboarding checklist & adaptive empty states
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design a compact, beacon-style onboarding module that surfaces a sequential checklist and context-aware empty states across the Console first-run funnel. Deliverables: Figma components (compact checklist card, empty-state canvases, microtip popovers), a screenshot matrix for 3 device widths, copy variants for A/B tests, and a handoff package with implementation notes for Engineering. Focus: reduce cognitive overhead on first-run flows, increase completion rate for critical setup steps (api keys, model selection, workspace), and provide graceful empty states that point to next actions.
comments: 2026-03-01 - AM: Initial ticket created after kickoff with PM; scope narrowed to compact module + empty states to keep phase 1 lightweight.
2026-03-03 - PO: Priya Shah: prioritize API key and model selection flows; recommend telemetry hooks for completion metric.
2026-03-05 - LO'C: Engineering review — prefer CSS-based tooltip for microtips; requested animation budget limit (max 200ms).
2026-03-07 - AM: Early Figma exploration uploaded; two visual directions (beacon-strip vs. card-stack). Linked to attachments.
2026-03-09 - PR: Design critique — choose card-stack for accessibility; card has dense layout for keyboard users and clear focus states. Action: finalize microcopy variants and localization tokens.
2026-03-10 - LO'C: Implementability check complete; added list of DOM anchors for microtips and a11y checklist request.
2026-03-10 - AM: Updated acceptance criteria to include screenshot matrix and localization-ready copy files.
2026-03-10 - Next: Prepare handoff package and mark for Design Review (2026-03-12).
acceptance_criteria: Compact checklist component implemented in Figma with component variants and tokens
3 empty-state templates (no-data, quota-reached, integration-missing) with actionable CTA
Screenshot matrix captured for widths: 1280px, 1024px, 768px and annotated for engineering
Microcopy includes 3 variants per CTA for A/B test and localization keys (en, fr, de)
Accessibility: keyboard focus states, aria-label recommendations, contrast checks passed
Engineering implementation notes and DOM anchor list delivered in handoff package
design_notes: Microcopy tone: concise, action-forward. Primary CTAs use verbs: 'Add API key', 'Select model', 'Create route'
Card-stack chosen for better vertical rhythm and smaller vertical real estate on narrow screens
Empty states must include primary CTA + secondary learn-more link; secondary link opens contextual help drawer
Animations: fade-in + translateY (max 200ms, ease-out) to avoid motion sickness; disable by media query 'prefers-reduced-motion'
Localization: avoid concatenated strings; use placeholder tokens for workspace and model names
Telemetry: each checklist item toggles 'started' and 'completed' events with item_id and duration
screenshot_tasks: Capture desktop (1280x800) – checklist expanded + one microtip active
Capture tablet (1024x768) – compact collapsed state + empty-state (no-data)
Capture narrow (768x1024) – stacked cards, keyboard focus visible
Annotate each screenshot with component name, variant, and snapshot test key
Produce masked screenshots for public docs (remove workspace names and keys)
risks: Too many actions on the compact card may increase cognitive load — mitigated by progressive reveal
Localization length expansion could break compact layout — reserve 20% flexible width in token design
Telemetry instrument gaps if engineering disagrees on event schema — coordinate in handoff
